name: Hayy Jameel
known: Its chairman and founder is Fady Jameel, whose grandfather Abdul Latif Jameel started the family business in 1945 (hayyjameel.org founder page).
Fady Jameel is also Deputy President and Vice Chairman, International Operations, at Abdul Latif Jameel, the family business (hayyjameel.org founder page).
Hayy Jameel and its parent Art Jameel publish no annual reports, accounts or funder list; the site lists staff and the founder but no board.

name: Misk Art Institute
known: Artist Ahmed Mater was its founding director (The Art Newspaper, 2017).
Ahmed Mater was its director then.

name: Dak'Art Biennale
known: Wikipedia lists the Senegalese government as founder and the general secretary of the Dakar Biennale as organiser.
Artistic director Morad Montazami.

name: Kër Thiossane
known: Pixelache names Marion Louisgrand-Sylla and François Sylla as founders.

name: Musée Boribana
known: Founded by the Senegalese anthropologist Boubacar Koné and his wife, the actress CCH Pounder (DakArtNews, 6 July 2026).
The same article announced that a conservator, Hawa Mara Ba, formerly a cultural adviser at the Ministry of Culture and Communication, would take up her post that week.
It has been a state museum since the founder donated it in December 2014 and sits with the Dak'Art Biennale and other state sites under the culture ministry.
A conservator from the Ministry of Culture took office in March 2015.

name: Musée Théodore Monod d'Art Africain (IFAN)
known: Renamed in December 2007 for the naturalist Théodore Monod, a former IFAN director (Wikipedia).

The museum's partners page names 11 partners: the Senegalese arts directorate, Fondation SOCOCIM, the French embassy in Dakar, Grand Palais RMN, the Goethe-Institut, the Gerda Henkel Foundation, the Senegalese heritage directorate, Fondation TOTAL Sénégal, the Institut français, the Institut françai
Curator El Hadji Malick Ndiaye said in March 2023 that it was among "quelques partenariats avec le privé national" and had renovated the museum in 2010 (Seneweb).

le19M, the craftsmanship hub of Chanel (FashionUnited): the curator said in 2023 that le19M renovated one of the museum's two buildings, including wiring, lighting, flooring and security, and paid for research and the garden (Seneweb).

name: Musée des Civilisations Noires
known: Curator Ery Camara sees a Chinese pagoda in the circular form while others see Wolof houses (Mail & Guardian).
Director: Hamady Bocoum at the 2018 opening (Wikipedia).

Professor Mouhamed Abdalah Ly was the museum's director in 2025 (Sud Quotidien via AllAfrica, 14 February 2026) and announced his resignation as Director General on his Facebook page in May 2026 (Sud Quotidien via AllAfrica, 26 May 2026).

name: Raw Material Company
known: Set up in 2008 as a mobile site for artistic practice and critical exchange, with the curator Koyo Kouoh as founding artistic director (au-senegal.com;
Kouoh was founding artistic director from 2008 to 2019, then moved to Zeitz MOCAA in Cape Town.
The Mellon Foundation awarded Myriad USA $345,000 over 24 months on 21 December 2022 to support RAW's curatorial work, artistic education and archiving (Mellon Foundation).

name: Center for Cultural Decontamination (CZKD)
known: Independent non-profit cultural centre in the Veljković Pavilion at Birčaninova 21, Belgrade, known as "Kod Borke" after its founder (Radio Slobodna Evropa, 2010).
Founded by Borka Pavićević, formerly a principal of the Yugoslav Drama Theatre, in 1994 (Wikipedia).

name: Museum of Contemporary Art Belgrade
known: Protić as founder and first director (museum history page).
In 2019 the museum's board sent the Ministry a report on four director candidates, and the Minister nominated one in March 2019 (CIMAM).
On 30 January 2020 the government replaced acting director Slobodan Nakarada with Viktor Kiš despite a 2019 open call.
Board chair resigned;

name: NTU Centre for Contemporary Art Singapore
known: National research centre of Nanyang Technological University (NTU), presenting itself as a space for critical discourse on "Spaces of the Curatorial" in Southeast Asia and beyond (centre website).
Ute Meta Bauer was founding director and is listed as Acting Director and Principal Research Fellow on the centre's website (Wikipedia, centre website).
Bauer and some staff planned to continue research and curatorial programmes from a Singapore office (The Art Newspaper, Lisa Movius, 12 October 2020).

name: National Gallery Singapore
known: Founding partners: DBS, UOB, Keppel, Far East Organization, Ngee Ann Kongsi and Singtel (Chairman's message);

name: Post-Museum
known: The founders describe going nomadic as a way to "practice the city" (Artshelp).
In the On Curating interview (Carolina Sanchez, Issue 41) the founders said of the early years: "we didn't want to take any funding from government agencies."
The founders' position has since shifted: "we want to see more public engagement with government agencies" (On Curating), which Artshelp describes as a wish for larger-scale collaborations.
